protocol.engine: installed VoxType Parakeet TDT ONNX, CPU
protocol.input: original public WAV; identical VoxType mono/resampling path for both models
protocol.postprocessing: none; file-only transcribe command; no desktop output
protocol.wer: corpus word errors / reference words; lowercase ASCII word tokens
protocol.structured_wer: per-entity acoustic/canonical alternatives; acoustic word-count denominator
protocol.latency_scope: whole CLI invocation including model load; NOT warm dictation latency
protocol.privacy: no reference transcripts, model transcripts, or private audio saved
protocol.limits: 55-clip convenience sample at default limit; not user voice or a hidden holdout
protocol.entity_accuracy: CTEM/TSR not measured; WER is not exact structured-value correctness
